objects.description: [Contagious Interview](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) has developed malware that utilizes Qt cross-platform framework to include [BeaverTail](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1246).(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)(Citation: PaloAlto Unit42 ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibileFerret October 2024)
objects.description_fa: [مصاحبه مسری](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1052) بدافزاری را توسعه داده است که از چارچوب کراس پلتفرم Qt برای شامل کردن [BeaverTail](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1246) استفاده می‌کند.(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_1] (Citation: PaloAlto Unit42 ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibileFerret October 2024)
